# V-Bot Mind MCP

> Autonomous virtual robot brain — perception, LLM reasoning, episodic memory, personality, and motor output for fleet V-Bots in Godot, Unity3D, and Resonite.

## Quick Links

- [README](README.md) — Full project overview
- Skill: `skill://vbot-mind/SKILL.md` — How to use V-Bot Mind

## Core Tools

- `vbot_mind` — Full V-Bot lifecycle portmanteau (9 operations)
- `vbot_agentic_workflow` — Multi-step autonomous goal pursuit

## Configuration

- `VBOT_MIND_LLM_BASE_URL` — LLM provider (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1)
- `VBOT_MIND_LLM_MODEL` — Model name (default: qwen2.5:7b)

## Key Files

- `src/vbot_mind/mcp/tools/vbot_mind_tools.py` — Main portmanteau tool
- `src/vbot_mind/mcp/tools/vbot_agentic.py` — Agentic workflow tool
- `src/vbot_mind/mcp/models/portmanteau.py` — Pydantic models
- `src/vbot_mind/config.py` — Configuration
- `webapp/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — React dashboard
